name: World Cup Winners
description: Champions, hosts and unforgettable moments from the FIFA World Cup, men’s and women’s.
question: {prompt}

cards.prompt: Which nation won the first FIFA World Cup, in 1930?
cards.fact: Uruguay hosted too, and beat neighbors Argentina 4–2 in the final.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1934 World Cup on home soil?
cards.fact: Italy won again in 1938, becoming the first team to defend the title.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1950 World Cup, stunning hosts Brazil at the Maracanã?
cards.fact: Brazilians still call the shock defeat the "Maracanazo."

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1954 World Cup in the "Miracle of Bern"?
cards.fact: West Germany beat a Hungary side that had been unbeaten for four years.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1958 World Cup, with a 17-year-old Pelé scoring in the final?
cards.fact: It is still the only World Cup a South American team has won in Europe.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1966 World Cup at Wembley?
cards.fact: Geoff Hurst’s hat-trick was the only one in a men’s World Cup final until Kylian Mbappé’s in 2022.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1970 World Cup in Mexico, often called the greatest team ever?
cards.fact: It was Brazil’s third title, so it kept the original Jules Rimet Trophy for good.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1974 World Cup on home soil, beating Johan Cruyff’s Netherlands?
cards.fact: It was the first final played for the current World Cup trophy.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1978 World Cup as hosts?
cards.fact: The Netherlands lost a second straight final, again to the host nation.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1982 World Cup in Spain?
cards.fact: Paolo Rossi went from a scoreless start to top scorer with six goals.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1986 World Cup, led by Diego Maradona?
cards.fact: Maradona’s "Hand of God" goal and his solo "Goal of the Century" both came against England.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1990 World Cup in Italy?
cards.fact: It was the last tournament before German reunification later that year.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1994 World Cup, the first final decided on penalties?
cards.fact: Roberto Baggio sent Italy’s final penalty over the bar.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1998 World Cup on home soil?
cards.fact: Zinedine Zidane headed two goals in the 3–0 final against Brazil.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2002 World Cup, its record fifth title?
cards.fact: Ronaldo scored both goals in the final against Germany.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2006 World Cup in Germany?
cards.fact: The final is remembered for Zinedine Zidane’s headbutt on Marco Materazzi.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2010 World Cup, its first title?
cards.fact: Andrés Iniesta scored the winner in extra time against the Netherlands.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2014 World Cup in Brazil?
cards.fact: Germany beat the hosts 7–1 in the semi-final on the way.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2018 World Cup in Russia?
cards.fact: Teenager Kylian Mbappé scored in the 4–2 final win over Croatia.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2022 World Cup in Qatar?
cards.fact: Lionel Messi finally lifted the trophy after a 3–3 final won on penalties.

cards.prompt: Which country hosted the 1994 World Cup?
cards.fact: Its total attendance record of about 3.6 million stood for decades.

cards.prompt: The 2002 World Cup was the first co-hosted by two countries. Which two?
cards.fact: It was also the first World Cup held in Asia.

cards.prompt: Which country hosted the 2010 World Cup, the first in Africa?
cards.fact: The droning vuvuzela horns became the tournament’s soundtrack.

cards.prompt: Which country hosted the 2022 World Cup, the first played in November and December?
cards.fact: The tournament moved to winter to avoid the Gulf’s summer heat.

cards.prompt: The 2026 World Cup was the first hosted by three countries. Which three?
alts: Canada, Mexico and the United States
options: United States, Mexico and Costa Rica
cards.fact: It was also the first World Cup with 48 teams.

cards.prompt: Who is the only player to win three men’s World Cups?
cards.fact: Pelé won in 1958, 1962 and 1970.

cards.prompt: Which player scored the "Hand of God" goal in 1986?
cards.fact: Four minutes later, Maradona dribbled past half the England team for the "Goal of the Century."

cards.prompt: After the 2022 tournament, which nation had won the most men’s World Cups?
cards.fact: Brazil had five titles; Germany and Italy had four each.

cards.prompt: What was the original World Cup trophy called?
cards.fact: It was stolen in England in 1966 and found by a dog named Pickles.

cards.prompt: What is the award for the World Cup’s top goalscorer commonly called?
cards.fact: The Golden Ball goes to the best player, and the Golden Glove to the best goalkeeper.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the first FIFA Women’s World Cup, in 1991?
cards.fact: The tournament was held in China, with 12 teams.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 1999 Women’s World Cup, sealed by Brandi Chastain’s penalty?
cards.fact: More than 90,000 fans watched the final at the Rose Bowl.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2011 Women’s World Cup in Germany?
cards.fact: Japan beat the United States on penalties, months after the Tōhoku earthquake.

cards.prompt: Which nation won the 2023 Women’s World Cup, its first title?
cards.fact: The tournament was co-hosted by Australia and New Zealand.
